changeSet.author: grushton
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ontology_index ( term_id varchar(255) primary key, version varchar(255) not null, ontology varchar(255) not null, synonyms text, label text not null, usable boolean not null, json jsonb, create_user_id integer not null, create_date timestamp without time zone default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null, update_user_id integer, update_date timestamp without time zone, search_vector tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( to_tsvector( 'english', coalesce(term_id, '') || ' ' || coalesce(label, '') || ' ' || coalesce(synonyms, '') ) ) STORED );
